basic_info.description: When calling please dial #415-876-1100 ext 102Clean, quiet, elegant 2 bedroom 2 bathroom condominium located in the luxurious Madrone Mission Bay and just steps away from AT&T Park, home of the World Champions San Francisco Giants and the newly constructed world class UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital. The unit, built in 2012, offers high-end stainless steel appliances (Bosch gas top stove and oven and Thermador refrigerator and freezer. Kitchen area with dark stone counter-tops opens up to the dining/living room. Floor to ceiling windows that let in fantastic natural light. The open floor plan is ideal for entertaining. All finishes are top of the line. Both bedrooms are carpeted with warm high quality material. Stackable washer and dryer in the unit.Madrone amenities are top of the line and include attended lobbies, outdoor pool & spa, sauna, resident's lounge, fitness center, theater room & more. Public transportation is proximate and the 280/101 Freeways are easily accessible.Unit comes with one parking space and a larger storage unit included in the rent.Minimum one year lease term. Must have credit scores above 700, good references and verifiable income. Pets negotiable with references.
